name: Albury Plumbing and Gas
description: Albury Plumbing and Gas is a licensed plumbing and gasfitting business covering residential, commercial and rural work across Albury and Wodonga. Services listed include hot water system installations, gas repairs and leaks, LPG installations, gas cooktop installation, blocked drains, water leak detection, pipe relining, toilet and shower installations and bathroom renovations. The business also carries out backflow prevention and testing, high pressure water jet drain cleaning, CCTV drain inspections and rainwater tank installations. Emergency plumbing is offered seven days.
highlights: Plumbing and gasfitting, including LPG installations
CCTV drain inspections and high pressure water jetting
Covers Albury, Wodonga, Lavington and Thurgoona

name: Albury Wodonga Plumbing Services
description: Albury Wodonga Plumbing Services is a plumbing business working on both sides of the border and licensed in NSW and Victoria. Listed services include hot water repairs and installation, blocked drain repairs, hydro jet drain cleaning, gas appliance repairs, roof repairs, gutter and downpipe replacements, water pipe replacements, solar hot water maintenance, backflow testing and thermostatic mixing valves. The business also takes on kitchen and bathroom renovations and hires out excavator and earthmoving equipment. A 24/7 emergency service is advertised.
highlights: Licensed in both NSW and Victoria
Hydro jet drain cleaning and blocked drain repairs

name: Wello's Plumbing & Gas
description: Wello's Plumbing & Gas is a family owned plumbing and gasfitting business based at Table Top Road, Thurgoona. The site lists blockages, pipe relining, mini excavation, hot water repairs, gas heating repairs, ducted cooling repairs, renovations and compliance work. The business advertises a 24 hour service and covers Albury, Wodonga, Lavington and Thurgoona.
highlights: Pipe relining and blocked drain clearing
Gas heating and ducted cooling repairs
NSW and Victorian plumbing licences held

name: Albury Plumbing Services
description: Albury Plumbing Services is a local, licensed and insured plumbing business operating from Ceres Drive, Thurgoona. The site lists burst pipes, blocked sewers and stormwater drains, leak detection, CCTV pipe inspections, general repairs and maintenance, hot water repairs and replacements and toilet cistern repair and replacement. Work covers both residential and commercial properties, and the business states it is available 24/7. Service areas listed are Albury, Lavington, Jindera, Thurgoona and Table Top in NSW, plus Wodonga and Leneva in Victoria.
highlights: CCTV pipe inspections and leak detection
Blocked sewer and stormwater drain clearing
Covers Jindera, Table Top and Wodonga as well as Albury

name: Engage Electrics
description: Engage Electrics is an electrical contractor working across the Albury-Wodonga border region. The site lists residential work for new homes, extensions and power points, commercial work for shops, renovations and industrial sheds, plus re-wiring and general maintenance. The business also installs solar systems and states it has Clean Energy Council accredited designers and installers. Listed service towns include Albury, Lavington, Howlong, Culcairn and Holbrook in NSW and Wodonga, Beechworth, Chiltern, Rutherglen and Tallangatta in Victoria.
highlights: Residential, commercial and industrial electrical work
Solar installation with CEC accredited designers and installers
Works across both NSW and Victorian border towns

name: Mick Curtis Electrical
description: Mick Curtis Electrical is a Wodonga based electrical contractor covering domestic, commercial and industrial work. Domestic services listed are renovations, rewires and lighting upgrades; commercial services cover new fit-outs, repairs, troubleshooting and maintenance; industrial work includes repairs, upgrades, maintenance and new installations. The business holds Victorian and NSW electrical licences and an ARC refrigerant handling licence, and lists Albury, Wodonga, Lavington and Rutherglen as service areas.
highlights: Domestic rewires, renovations and lighting upgrades
Serves Albury, Wodonga, Lavington and Rutherglen

name: D.N. Bishop & Co Pty Ltd
description: D.N. Bishop & Co is an electrical contracting firm on Thomas Mitchell Drive, Wodonga, servicing Albury, Wodonga and districts. Listed work includes commercial construction, certificates of electrical safety, appliance testing and tagging, emergency exit lighting, specialist appliance repairs and telephone and data cabling. The business also holds EEHA accreditation for hazardous area electrical works. A 24 hour breakdown service is available by arrangement, and weekend and public holiday work is by appointment.
highlights: Hazardous area electrical works with EEHA accreditation

name: KDEC Electrical and Solar
description: KDEC Electrical and Solar operates from Ruby Court, Albury, and covers solar power, energy storage and general electrical work. The site lists solar power systems, battery energy storage, EV charge stations, LED lighting, off grid energy systems, general electrical work and data transfer including optical fibre solutions. The business holds NSW and Victorian electrical licences and states accreditation in CEC Design and Install, Grid Connect Battery and Stand Alone Power Systems.
highlights: Solar power systems and battery energy storage
Off grid and stand alone power systems
LED lighting and general electrical work

name: Connect Solar & Electrical
description: Connect Solar & Electrical is a Clean Energy Council accredited solar installer and electrical contractor based in the Albury Wodonga region. The site lists residential and commercial solar systems, solar hot water, solar monitoring technology, air conditioning, electrical work for new homes and renovations, and test and tag services. Listed service towns include Thurgoona, Lavington, Jindera, Howlong, Baranduda, Yackandandah, Chiltern, Barnawartha, Beechworth, Corowa and Wangaratta.
highlights: Clean Energy Council accredited solar installer
Solar hot water and system monitoring

name: Alatalo Bros
description: Alatalo Bros is a family owned builder and land developer with its Albury-Wodonga office at 60-62 Hovell Street, Wodonga. The business offers house and land packages, land-only sales and custom home builds, and has display homes at 6 Westacott Crescent, Baranduda. It also operates an office at East Wagga and builds in Albury, Wodonga, Thurgoona, Baranduda and Leneva.
highlights: Family owned builder and land developer
House and land packages plus land-only sales
Display homes at Westacott Crescent, Baranduda
Builds in Albury, Wodonga, Thurgoona and Leneva

name: Hawk Renovations
description: Hawk Renovations is a licensed building business in Albury handling bathroom, kitchen and laundry renovations from design through to construction. The business also carries out carpentry work including decks, pergolas and structural timber work, and holds both NSW and Victorian building licences. Listed service areas include Albury, Wodonga, Thurgoona, Lavington, North Albury, East Albury, Jindera, Howlong, Baranduda, Leneva and Glenroy.
highlights: Design through to construction managed in house
Covers Albury, Wodonga, Jindera, Howlong and Baranduda

name: WB Carpentry
description: WB Carpentry is a licensed carpentry business based on Hovell Street, South Albury. The business states it specialises in all things carpentry, including the construction of new homes, renovations and extensions, outdoor living areas, fencing and retaining walls.

name: Pro Vision Carpentry & Glazing
description: Pro Vision Carpentry & Glazing is a carpentry and glazing business working across the Albury-Wodonga region. The site lists decks and pergolas, residential framing, cladding as a James Hardie specialist, renovations, glazing and concreting. Listed service areas are Albury, Wodonga, Lavington, Thurgoona, Baranduda, East Albury, Holbrook, Corryong and surrounds.

name: Brushworks Painting
description: Brushworks Painting is a North Albury based painting business that has been working in Albury for 24 years. The site lists residential and commercial painting, interior and exterior house painting, repairs and home improvements, and epoxy floor painting and epoxy flake flooring. Service areas listed are Albury, Lavington, Thurgoona and Wodonga.
highlights: Epoxy floor and epoxy flake flooring

name: Schmutter Painting & Decorating
description: Schmutter Painting & Decorating is a house painting business working across Albury, Wodonga and the surrounding border region. The site lists interior and exterior house painting, commercial painting, repaints and renovations, new builds, and decks, fences and feature finishes.
highlights: Covers Albury, Wodonga and the border region

name: L.J. Ellery Roofing
description: L.J. Ellery Roofing has provided metal roofing services in Albury, Wodonga and surrounds since 2011, working from Buckingham Street, North Albury. Listed services are roof replacements, roof repairs, roof and gutter leaks, gutter replacements, fascia, downpipes and roof rectification, along with whirlybirds, skylights, gutter guard and maintenance. Service areas listed include Lavington, North, South, East and West Albury, Thurgoona, Wodonga, Corowa, Rutherglen, Holbrook and Wangaratta.

name: The Roofer Troopers
description: The Roofer Troopers is a locally owned roofing company based on the Riverina Highway at Howlong. The business specialises in roof installations, repairs and maintenance, along with gutters, gutter guards, fascias, soffits, skylights, whirlybirds and cladding. Listed service areas cover Albury, Lavington, Thurgoona, East and North Albury, Wodonga, Corowa, Rutherglen, Howlong, Wangaratta, Beechworth and surrounding rural properties. Free quotes are advertised.
highlights: Gutters, gutter guards, fascias and soffits

name: Big River Roofing
description: Big River Roofing is a roofing contractor on Wigg Street, Wodonga, working on commercial and residential roofs across Albury, Wodonga and surrounding areas. Listed services are commercial roofing, Colorbond roofing, re-roofing, roof restoration, roof repairs and roof assessments. The business holds Victorian and NSW plumbing licences and a NSW roof tiling licence.

name: Colombera Constructions
description: Colombera Constructions is a family owned concreting and construction business on Sangsters Road, Wodonga. The site lists residential and commercial concreting, decorative concrete, industrial concrete solutions, site preparation, formwork, concrete cutting and coring, demolition work, plumbing and civil drainage, custom home building and home maintenance and repairs. The business holds Victorian domestic and commercial building registrations and a Victorian plumbing licence.
highlights: Also registered for building and plumbing work

name: David Son Tiling
description: David Son Tiling is a family tiling business based in Springdale Heights and servicing Albury, Wodonga and surrounds. The site lists wall and floor tiling, bathroom renovation, tile lifting and removal, pavers, waterproofing, and tile and grout cleaning.

name: Twin City Fencing
description: Twin City Fencing installs residential Colorbond fencing, commercial and industrial fencing and pool fencing across the border region. The business works by appointment from Monday to Friday. Listed service towns include Albury, Lavington, Table Top, Jindera, Thurgoona, Wodonga, Rutherglen, Howlong, Yackandandah, Beechworth, Tallangatta and Corowa.
highlights: Covers Jindera, Table Top, Corowa and Beechworth

name: SLIDE Living
description: SLIDE Living is a locally owned fencing, landscaping and outdoor construction business servicing Albury-Wodonga and surrounds. Fencing work covers Colorbond, slat, modular, pool, timber and tubular steel, plus private school fencing. The business also builds retaining walls in timber, block, rock and concrete sleeper, and offers landscaping, irrigation, excavation, garden shed installation and timber and composite decking. Free site visits and fixed quotes are advertised.
highlights: Colorbond, slat, timber and pool fencing
Retaining walls in timber, block, rock and concrete sleeper
Free site visits and fixed quotes

name: Executive Garden Scapes
description: Executive Garden Scapes is a landscape construction and maintenance company based at Ruby Court, East Albury, working across the commercial, government and residential sectors. Listed services are landscaping, decking, irrigation, turfing, retaining walls, paving, plant selection and mulching, and project management.

name: Edmondson Landscapes
description: Edmondson Landscapes provides custom landscape design and construction to Albury, Wodonga and surrounds, and is licensed in both NSW and Victoria. The site lists irrigation installation, maintenance and repair, paving and edging, turf installation, garden and plant selection, and sustainable backyards with edible gardens and wildlife friendly plantings. Quotes and consultations are offered.
highlights: Edible gardens and wildlife friendly plantings

name: Brad Andrews Landscaping
description: Brad Andrews Landscaping is a family run landscaping company established in 1988 and based in Albury Wodonga, specialising in the planning, layout and construction of gardens and outdoor areas. The site lists pool paving and surrounds, retaining walls and rockwork, general landscaping, lighting and water features, and synthetic grass. The business holds Victorian and NSW licences.

name: Twin Cities Glass
description: Twin Cities Glass is a glazier on Ramsden Drive, North Albury, serving residential and commercial clients across Albury, Wodonga, North East Victoria and the Riverina. Listed services include glass repairs, glass replacement and installation, Low-E glass windows, and door and window installation, repair and replacement. The business advertises a 24 hour emergency glass replacement service.
highlights: Door and window repair and replacement
Covers Albury, Wodonga, North East Victoria and the Riverina

name: Wodonga Glass
description: Wodonga Glass is a glazier at 155 Melbourne Road, Wodonga, doing commercial and domestic work in Albury and Wodonga. Listed services include on-site glass replacement, glass cutting and fitting, custom mirrors with bevelling, perspex and lexan products, splashbacks, shower screens, windows and sliding doors, heater and fireplace glass, wardrobe glass doors, window security screens and emergency repairs.

name: Custom Air
description: Custom Air is an ARCtick certified air conditioning business on Schubach Street, East Albury, covering domestic and commercial installation and service. The site lists split systems, multi splits, cassettes, ducted systems and package units, along with new unit sales, dealer and warranty work. Listed service areas are Albury, Wodonga, Wangaratta, Corowa, Yackandandah, Mount Beauty and Holbrook.
highlights: Split, multi split, cassette and ducted systems
New unit sales plus dealer and warranty work

name: Albury Wodonga Heating and Cooling
description: Albury Wodonga Heating and Cooling is a heating and cooling showroom and service business at 321 Wagga Road, Lavington, and states it has serviced the region for more than 30 years. The business covers sales, service and installation of ducted gas heating, ducted evaporative cooling, reverse cycle and split systems, gas log fires, wood heaters, space heaters, wall furnaces, radiant tube and patio heaters, hydronic systems, hot water systems and ducted vacuum systems.
highlights: Ducted gas heating and evaporative cooling
Reverse cycle and split system installation
Gas log fires and wood heaters
Hydronic heating and hot water systems

name: Lopez Refrigeration & Air Conditioning
description: Lopez Refrigeration & Air Conditioning is a locally run family business on Annette Crescent, Lavington, with over 40 years of experience in cooling, heating and refrigeration. The site lists air conditioning sales, service and installation, ducted gas heating, refrigeration work, and service and support for inverter systems. The business also acts as a warranty agent and is ARCtick certified.
highlights: Over 40 years in cooling, heating and refrigeration
Air conditioning sales, service and installation

name: Elite Excavation Co.
description: Elite Excavation Co. is a Wodonga based civil earthworks and wet hire contractor. Listed services include civil contracting, dam construction, driveway construction, forestry mulching, retaining walls, site cuts, drainage excavations and earthmoving, plus equipment hire including laser grader and box grader attachments. The business states it works up to 100 km from its depot, covering Albury, Lavington, Thurgoona, Wodonga, Rutherglen, Chiltern, Beechworth, Corowa and Wangaratta.

name: TSA Earthworks
description: TSA Earthworks is a Baranduda based excavation and earthworks contractor taking on residential and large scale commercial projects. Listed services are excavation, piling, civil contracting, electrical civil contracting and rail works, along with crushed rock driveways, site cuts, spoil removal, rock walls, hardscaping, hard stands and solar farm works. The team holds rail safety certification and high risk licences including slewing mobile crane, elevating work platform, basic rigging and dogging.
highlights: Rail works with rail safety certification
Site cuts, spoil removal and crushed rock driveways
Rock walls, hardscaping and hard stands

name: S & E Cabinets
description: S & E Cabinets is a cabinet making and joinery workshop at 112 Boronia Street, North Albury, making custom built, made to measure kitchens and joinery. The site lists custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, laundry units, entertainment units, wardrobes, outdoor kitchens and BBQ units, custom joinery and sub-trade coordination.
highlights: Built at their North Albury workshop

name: Albury Wodonga Kitchens
description: Albury Wodonga Kitchens is a custom cabinetry and joinery workshop at 1086 Nowra Street, Albury. The business designs, manufactures and installs custom made cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, laundries and everything in between, and works with architects, builders and renovators on residential and commercial projects.
highlights: Custom kitchen, bathroom and laundry joinery
Design, manufacture and installation in house
Works with architects, builders and renovators

name: Twin City Sheds
description: Twin City Sheds is a custom shed builder at 30 Fallon Street, Thurgoona, supplying residential, commercial, farm and industrial sheds along with pergolas and patios. The office operates by appointment Monday to Friday. Listed service areas are Albury, Wodonga, Jindera, Thurgoona, Lavington, Table Top and surrounding regions.
highlights: Covers Jindera, Table Top and Lavington
